name: Harness check on any single-GPU instance: the benchmark with one rank and two layers

tasks.name: every optimizer path runs end to end (world size 1, 2 layers)
commands: python3 -c "import json,sys; r=[json.loads(l) for l in open('$OUT/smoke.jsonl')]; print(r and [(x['optimizer'], x['ok'], x.get('error','')[:200]) for x in r]); sys.exit(0 if r and all(x['ok'] for x in r) else 1)"
